# No use of cheat, exploits, or macros
Do not use external software / modified launchers to gain an unfair advantage against other players, this applies to but is not limited to:
- External software that directly exploits a vulnerability in SS14's code to do unintended behaviour
- External software / hardware that records / replays button presses.
(note that this doesnt apply to calculators as they calculate and they do not grant a calculative advantage towards players who cant count)
